title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass | Carolina Collection (Traditional) Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass, designed to bring timeless Carolina Collection style to traditional bathroom hardware.

  • Solid brass construction for an enduring, refined look
  • Concealed screw mounting for clean, classic bath accessories styling
  • Wall-mounted installation helps save floor space
  • Coordinated design for matching Carolina accessories across the Carolina Collection
  • Finish flexibility with multiple designer finish options available

Specifications

  • Collection: Carolina Collection
  • Style: Traditional
  • Shape: Straight bar
  • Material: Brass
  • Length: 30 in (center-to-center: 30 in)
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 3.5 in H x 2 in W
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Carolina Collection 30 Inch Towel Bar
_previous.description: The Carolina Collection towel bar from Allied Brass is a blend of elegant form and simplified detail. Made from the finest solid brass materials and finished with a lifetime decorative finish, this traditional towel bar is extremely attractive yet highly functional. The Carolina Collection has bath accessories to meet your design and decorating needs.
